bio: Enter the enchanting atmosphere of Café Nucleus Chatham, a captivating oasis nestled in the heart of Chatham's vibrant High Street. As an integral part of the Nucleus Arts Centre, the café offers a unique blend of sophistication and warmth, ensuring a stylish and always-welcoming atmosphere. Café Nucleus stands as a distinctive haven, infusing traditional café fare with a delightful European accent.  Adorned with a boutique interior featuring handmade British crockery and fine C&S crystal glassware, this charming setting beckons guests to unwind and revel in the joy of the season. From the luxurious White Company Noir hand soap to the state-of-the-art Bose & Sonos sound system, every detail enhances the ambiance, creating a one-of-a-kind destination on Chatham's High Street.  Experience the delightful offerings of the Afternoon Tea menu. Priced at £28 per person, indulge in a diverse selection of finger sandwiches, such as Dorset Coastal Cheddar with Homemade Caramelised Onions, Cucumber with Local Cream Cheese, and Kentish Honey Roast Ham with Tracklements English Mustard. Delight in a freshly baked fruited scone, paired with Rodda’s Cornish Clotted Cream and Wooden Spoon Strawberry champagne preserve. Elevate your culinary experience with a tempting assortment of Afternoon Fancies, featuring handmade petit fours, truffles, and macarons from Bénodet, Brittany. Café Nucleus captures the true essence of quality dining, offering an unparalleled and joyous experience on Chatham High Street.
